title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1997 The States of Madhya Pradesh (9234), Maharashtra (5150), Tamil Nadu (3659), Uttar Pradesh (3122), Andhra Pradesh (2369), Rajasthan (2211) and Punjab (2019) were the main centres which accommodated majority of the convict prisoners kept in Central Jails. District Jails of Madhya Pradesh (2203), Orissa (2083), Uttar Pradesh (1890) and Assam (1371) catered to a large number of convict prisoners. So far as Sub-Jails are concerned, the number of convicts in such jails was higher in Madhya Pradesh (544), Orissa (221), Punjab (139), Andhra Pradesh (118) and Gujarat (111). Borstal Schools in Madhya Pradesh reported highest Convicts (116) followed by Punjab (104).
